architecture: Alpha158 + five stock gates + category market-set encoders + MLP
pooling: mean embeddings of all active market rows per category, plus log(1 + count) and category missing flag
normalization: finite values in train segment only; unseen stock sensitivities = 1

missing_semantics.factor: 1 for non-finite values; 0 for finite values, including zero
missing_semantics.category: 1 if no real market row has any finite factor; 0 otherwise
missing_semantics.padding: excluded from pooling, counts and category availability
missing_semantics.values: missing values filled with 0 after normalization; only values scaled by stock sensitivities

label: cross-sectional zscore of close(T+2)/close(T+1)-1
membership_note: BaoStock historical CSI 300 snapshots update weekly. Files are queried as of each trading date; updateDate is retained and is not an official index effective date.
